messages:
rita (PM): quick thread: we need to finalize GA gating rules today. main questions: 1) what SLOs are required for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private? 2) what pilot commitments unlock Dedicated pricing? 3) docs/runbooks needed at GA?
kai (Eng): for SLOs we can propose tiered p95 targets: Hosted p95 <= 250ms, Dedicated <= 150ms, Private is customer-dependent but we must ship a baseline SLO doc.
sam (SRE): add availability SLOs: Hosted 99.9%, Dedicated 99.95 (if reserved), Private no SLA from us for on-prem but we provide monitoring templates.
mina (Support): support readiness: GA needs clear on-call routing, sample severity definitions, and a customer-facing incident template.
ivy (Docs): I'll own the runbook + customer onboarding guide. need list of required sections. propose: runbook, SLO doc, escalation ladder, troubleshooting matrix, sample contract language.
omar (Sales): important for pilots: customers expect trial Dedicated capacity with a short SLA. we should require pilots to sign a 3mo commitment to qualify for Dedicated GA pricing.
nina (Legal): 3mo commitments ok, but need to define termination clauses and SLA credit formula. pinged legal if you want boilerplate.
kai (Eng): technical gating: must have auto-scaling smoke tests, synthetic traffic across regions, and an admission-control guard for Dedicated to prevent noisy neighbors.
sam (SRE): monitoring gating: must have burn-rate alerts, error-budget dashboards per customer/route, and synthetic latency monitors hitting p95 targets.
rita (PM): proposed GA gating checklist (draft):
- Tiered SLO doc published (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
- On-call runbook + sample incident templates in docs
- Dedicated pilot program terms published (3mo min commit)
- Autoscale and synthetic tests passing in staging for 2w
- Billing + overage rules defined and tested
- Legal sign-off on SLA credits
- Observability: per-route error budgets and alerts
- Support training completed (2 dry-run tickets)

omar (Sales): billing rules need to cover burst overage. propose: soft limit first 5% free then 2x unit price for overage. customers want predictability.
billing-bot: note -> created draft billing matrix: /docs/billing/draft-burst-matrix.csv
mina (Support): training: I can run dry-run tickets next Thur. need sample incident of Dedicated burst failure + customer communication template.
ivy (Docs): will draft communication templates and onboarding checklist. ETA EOD Wed for first pass.
nina (Legal): SLA credits formula: prorated % of monthly invoice based on downtime beyond SLA threshold, capped at 50% monthly fee. need Product sign-off on thresholds.
kai (Eng): can we define the Dedicated admission-control behavior: queue vs reject? Rejection returns 429 with Retry-After, queue increases latency. Prefer reject with clear message for SLA.
sam (SRE): agree. queueing hurts latency SLAs. for SLA we should reject and have priority routing for reserved tenants.
rita (PM): decision: Dedicated SLA paths will reject excess traffic and return a structured 429 with tier info. We'll document fallback guidance.
omar (Sales): pilots must opt into fallback behavior and receive sample contract language. I need that doc to negotiate.
ivy (Docs): I'll include sample 429 case + guidance and suggested SDK retry logic snippet.
mina (Support): also add playbook steps: notify customer, open follow-up ticket, propose remedial capacity options.
billing-bot: alert -> draft pricing tier posted at /marketing/pricing/staging-burst.md
rita (PM): final items to close for GA: support + docs ready, legal + billing sign-off, 2w of synthetic pass, and pilot terms posted. if all green we'll mark GA ready. owners: Kai (eng) autoscale + admission-control, Sam (SRE) monitoring + SLO dashboards, Ivy (Docs) runbooks & templates, Mina (Support) training, Omar (Sales) pilot terms, Nina (Legal) SLA credits.
kai (Eng): ack. spike on admission-control behavior starts tomorrow.
sam (SRE): I'll schedule synthetic runs and share dashboards link once ready.
ivy (Docs): will post first draft link by Wed EOD.
mina (Support): training slots booked for Thu.
omar (Sales): I'll prep pilot one-pager and send to Legal.
nina (Legal): will review and return redlines in 48h.
billing-bot: scheduled -> doc: "GA-gating-checklist" created by rita at 4322007965
rita (PM): thanks everyone. tiny ask: if your item is blocked, add a short note in the doc. we'll review blockers in Friday partner sync. :sparkles:
